verdicts.reason: A has no collisions, but the SOLSTICE wordmark sits awkwardly up and to the left of the headline instead of aligning with it. There is a dead gap between the phone and the text, the CTA is stacked under a badge at the same width so it barely stands out, the right ~170px is empty, and the subline is tiny. B has a clear collision: the 'Find It Near You' CTA covers the 'SUMMER ONLY' badge and cuts it off at 'SUMME'. Its CTA is also jammed against the right edge, the phone is cropped at the top and bottom, and the subline floats loosely above the badges.
